_notes: Every value here is a PLACEHOLDER until the data/pitch owner replaces it with a sourced number and sets that block's 'source'.
Units: rates and fractions are decimals (0.07 = 7%). Money is USD. Energy is kWh per year. Carbon is kg CO2 per kWh.

savings_mu / savings_sd: fraction of the building's whole annual energy spend saved at full coverage. Exception: rooftop_solar, where it is the realized fraction of modeled generation (kW x city solar yield).
unit_cost is in cost_unit, which matches the size_unit the feasibility rules (TRD section 7) produce.
carbon_price.start_year_range is years from today; price_range_per_tonne is USD per tonne CO2.
kwh_per_sqft_year keys are benchmark types, not CoStar names. buildings.py maps CoStar property_type to them; unknown types use 'Other'.
Full field definitions and example sources: ASSUMPTIONS.md.
Houston only. The Goal schema still allows 'Los Angeles' (TRD), but there are no LA values, so the engine cannot price LA buildings.

Values mapped 2026-11-14 from origin/nessie_data:backend/data/simulation_assumptions/houston.json @1f763d7 (AI-researched by the data lane; 'estimated' rows have no source URL). Remaining PLACEHOLDER fields are named in each block's source.
